player_prompt.intro:
Uri kutevedzera Tower of Hanoi ne {num_disks} disks.
Una kuzvisogedza kubva kwenye tower A kuenda tower C.
Kusogedza disk, andika tower yekutanga na tower ye kutanga (saka, '[A C]').
Ona kwamba unogona kusogedza disk iri pamaruwa pe tower, na kwamba disk kubva iri kudzika haigoni kutariswa kudzika disk ndogo.
Pa kila turn, taura move imwe.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Makataura kuti chiteshi chinobva kana kuti chinoda kuendeswa kwachiri hachishandi.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Wakaedza kutamisa dhisiki kubva mushongwe isina chinhu.
invalid_move.same_tower: Wakaedza kutamisa dhisiki kuchigadziko chimwe chetecho.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Wakaedza kuisa dhisiki hombe pane duku.

outcome.turn_limit: Muganhu wekutendeuka wasvika. Wakaisa zvakarurama {pct}% yemadhisiki paShongwe C.
